visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a black baseball cap is filming a selfie video in a narrow urban alley. He is smiling widely and pointing his finger upwards. A middle-aged woman wearing a white t-shirt with a red collar and blue denim jeans walks into the frame from the left side, laughing and touching her hair. The background consists of grey stone buildings and a street lamp. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a brightly lit, modern hair salon with white walls and wooden doors. The woman is seated in a styling chair, looking into a large mirror. A male hairdresser with bleached blonde hair, wearing a black face mask and a green apron over a blue shirt, stands behind her, touching her shoulder-length brown hair which has visible grey roots. (3) The hairdresser holds up a large physical printout featuring a K-pop idol with long, wavy brown hair as a reference point. The woman laughs at the comparison. The camera uses medium close-up shots to capture their facial expressions and the hairdresser's hand movements as he prepares the styling tools and applies hair dye. (4) The woman is shown mid-process with her hair clipped up and covered in white padding. She holds a smartphone to her face, conducting a video call with a young man who appears on the phone screen. Her hair is now visibly dyed a dark magenta-red. (5) The woman's hair is now vibrant red and wet. Two stylists, including the blonde man and a woman in a black crop top, use blow dryers and brushes to style her hair. The lighting is bright studio light, reflecting off the shiny red hair. (6) The final phase shows the woman with her transformation complete. She has bright red hair with wispy bangs and soft waves. She is smiling broadly, posing for the camera, and touching her hair. She is seen applying lip balm in a close-up shot while looking at the camera.
